result.title: Gated Prototype Transfer for Zero-Support Medical Vision Language Model
result.comment: Accepted to Symposium on Model Accountability, Sustainability and Healthcare 2026
result.summary: Realistic few-shot adaptation of medical vision-language models (VLMs) can leave low-prevalence classes without any labeled support. The training-free SS- Text+ solver remains operational in this setting, but its zero-support prototypes receive no visual adaptation and fall back to a purely textual class prototype. We in- troduce Gated Knowledge-Guided Prototype Transfer (GProtoT), a pre-repulsion module that transfers supported-class visual residuals to missing classes using VLM similarity and an ontology-based clinical distance. A validation-free evidence gate scales transfer based on semantic relevance and residual agreement, thereby limiting unsupported extrapolation. In 50 paired realistic one-shot trials on MESSIDOR with FLAIR features, severe and proliferative diabetic retinopathy were absent from every support set. Relative to SS-Text+, gated ProtoT improved missing-class recall by 5.23 points, average class accuracy by 1.37 points, and the missing/supported recall harmonic mean by 1.83 points. It reduced negative- transfer frequency from 46-48% for ungated transfer to 2%, while at the cost of reductions of 1.20 percentage points in supported-class recall and 0.45 percentage points in top-1 accuracy. These results indicate that evidence-based gating provides a safety mechanism for the knowledge source. GProtoT is based on SS- Text+ and requires no gradients, validation data, or additional model inference, of- fering a low-compute path toward accountable adaptation under incomplete clini- cal supervision. Code is available: https://github.com/sumaiyaafridi/GProtoT

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GProtoT：在存在零支持类别的少样本医学 VLM 适配中，借助 VLM 相似度与本体临床距离，将有支持类别的视觉残差迁移给缺失类别，并用无需验证集的证据门控抑制过度外推。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按语义相关性与残差一致性缩放迁移的门控，可作为「何时可信地使用视觉残差/迁移表示」的线索，供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与表示更新的可靠性判断；但本文不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成。
